synthesis:draft.headline: Peak 5-minute RRP in SA1 was 4981.0 $/MWh at 2026-07-31 02:05 ACST (UTC+0930).
summary: SA dispatch TOTALDEMAND in that 5-minute interval (2026-07-30T16:35:00Z / 2026-07-31 02:05 ACST (UTC+0930)) was 1472.82 MW (ev0434).
Net interconnector flow at the peak interval was -82.59 MW (net flow into SA) (ev0435).

The high-price episode reported covers 2026-07-30T04:30:00Z–2026-07-30T22:20:00Z and included 214 five-minute intervals at or above the analysis threshold (214 intervals >= $300.0/MWh) (ev1020 / ev1021; threshold ev0886 / ev1022).
Operational demand (30-minute measured) for the half-hour ending 2026-07-30T17:00:00Z was 1466.0 MW (ev0912).
The window maximum operational demand was 2173.0 MW (interval end 2026-07-30T09:30:00Z) (ev0897).

possible_explanations.statement: Interconnector transfer limits or an outage might have reduced the ability to import to SA (see the Tailem_Bnd inter-regional transfer limit notice [c2]); the net interchange at the peak interval was -82.59 MW (ev0435).
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Review the inter-regional transfer limit notice [c2] (it reports a rescheduled outage from 1830 hrs 28/07/2026 UTC 2026-07-28T08:30:00Z to 1200 hrs 01/08/2026 UTC 2026-08-01T02:00:00Z) and check interconnector transfer limit and constraint binding reports for intervals around 2026-07-30T16:35:00Z (2026-07-30T16:35:00Z is the peak interval UTC returned by get_price_timeline).

possible_explanations.statement: Local generation reductions or unit unavailability might have coincided with the high prices; generation-change observations show decreases at PPCCGT (change -76.51 MW, ev0942) and AGLHAL (change -72.11 MW, ev0954) alongside an increase at SNAPPER (change 99.46 MW, ev0939).
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Examine unit availability, outage records and bidding/rebid histories for units with changes reported in the 12:00–18:00 window (tool window 2026-07-30T12:00:00Z–2026-07-30T18:00:00Z) and compare offer volumes to actual dispatch.

possible_explanations.statement: A system non-credible contingency reported by AEMO might be relevant (the notice reports a 'Non-credible contingency event - SA region - 30/07/2026' [c1]).
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Compare the non-credible contingency notice [c1] clock_times (UTC 2026-07-30T01:40:00Z; local 2026-07-30 11:10 ACST (UTC+0930)) with dispatch and constraint actions following that notice to see whether any manifestly incorrect input (MII) review, constraint change or other operational action was recorded in subsequent intervals.

uncertainties: No bids/rebids and no full constraint-binding report were retrieved; these are needed to assess bidding behaviour and marginal constraint impacts.
Generation-change observations are SCADA-derived and do not alone establish whether changes were outages, scheduled changes or bidding responses.
